inputs.title: Choose the video and subtitle
inputs.description: Sync works on one pair at a time. Drop the files anywhere on this window or browse for them.
inputs.dropzone: Drop a video and a subtitle here

media.label: Video or audio
media.hint: The soundtrack the subtitle is measured against.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.hint: The file whose timing will be shifted.

inputs.subtitleOnly: Without a video or audio file there is nothing to analyse, so detection will be skipped and you set the offset yourself.

ask.title: Detect the offset automatically?
ask.description: Speech in the media is compared with the subtitle timing on this computer. You can also skip and adjust it yourself from 0.

running.title: Listening
running.description: Comparing speech with the subtitle timing. The next step opens when it finishes.

failed.title: No offset was detected
failed.description: Adjust the sensitivity and try again, or skip and adjust the offset yourself.

detect.needsMedia: Add a video or audio file in the first step to enable detection. You can still skip and set the offset yourself.

sensitivity.label: Speech sensitivity
sensitivity.hint: Lower is stricter: quieter passages are less likely to count as speech.
sensitivity.perRun: This applies to this run only and does not change your saved settings.

offset.title: Adjust the offset
offset.description: The value below is what will be applied. Adjust it if the result is close but not exact.
offset.label: Offset in milliseconds
offset.hint: A positive value delays the subtitles; a negative one makes them appear sooner.
offset.exceedsMax: This is beyond the {{limit}} second limit in your settings. Reduce it to continue.

none.title: No media to preview
none.description: Without a video or audio file there is nothing to play. You can still adjust the offset and continue.

preparing.failed: This video cannot be played here, so its sound is being prepared. You can keep adjusting the offset.
preparing.requested: Preparing the sound. You can keep adjusting the offset.

apply.title: Save the synced subtitle
apply.summary: Every cue will move by {{seconds}} seconds.
